symptom: label coverage depends on order age: orders 5-25 days old have labels for 13% of rows, orders 35-55 days old for 100%. A non-refunded order gets no row at all until its 30-day window closes, so recent unlabelled orders are undetermined, not negatives
resolution: training excludes orders whose refund window has not closed as of the prediction date; absence is never encoded as a negative
